Acheron is the fictional moon of Calpamos in Alien, home to Hadley’s Hope. Its rocky surface has a hostile atmosphere. Values come from the story: the diameter varies between sources and the mean temperature refers to terraforming. Mass, density, pressure and orbital elements are unknown. Sky pointing uses ζ² Reticuli as a scenic reference, not real moon ephemerides.
Alien: fictional setting. References: ALIEN RPG / Xenopedia. Direction: SIMBAD. Original AI-generated illustration; no film image.
